title: Apple Intelligence Is Coming to China, Powered by Alibaba's Qwen
description:
Apple Intelligence is coming to iPhones in China, with Alibaba's Qwen AI powering parts of Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence.
Developers can test it in the iOS beta from November 4, and everyone else gets it with iOS 27.3 in December. The new WWDC Siri isn't included yet.
